arguments.command:
cd /app/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,random,sys,subprocess
src=open('difftest.py').read().split('def main()')[0]
src=src.replace("sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))","")
ns={}
exec(src, ns)
gen_stream=ns['gen_stream']; gen_burst=ns['gen_burst']; PROG=ns['PROG']
rng=random.Random(1)
for i in range(50):
    obj = gen_stream(rng) if rng.random() < 0.5 else gen_burst(rng)
    proc=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',PROG],input=json.dumps(obj).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if proc.returncode!=0:
        print(json.dumps(obj)); print(proc.stdout[:200]); break
EOF
